en.headline: CUHK Medical Centre apologises after patient's ovaries removed by mistake
en.dek: A 45-year-old woman had both ovaries taken out during a planned laparoscopic hysterectomy in September; the Department of Health listed it as a sentinel event.
body: The Chinese University of Hong Kong Medical Centre said it had apologised to a 45-year-old female patient whose ovaries were inadvertently removed during laparoscopic surgery on 12 September that was intended to remove only her uterus and fallopian tubes.

The hospital said the surgeon experienced a brief cognitive lapse while focused on the procedure, and that a nurse later discovered the ovaries among the specimens. It reported the case to the Department of Health within 24 hours as a sentinel event and has begun an internal review; the surgeon admitted the error and will face disciplinary action under staff regulations.

The Department of Health said the patient was in stable condition and that it found no evidence the hospital had breached code-of-practice requirements on premises, staffing or equipment. A separate sentinel event involved a patient misidentified at a day procedure centre.

zh.headline: 中大醫院誤切除病人卵巢 院方致歉
zh.dek: 45歲女病人在計劃切除子宮及輸卵管的微創手術中卵巢被誤切，衞生署將事件列為嚴重醫療事故。
body: 香港中文大學醫院表示，一名45歲女病人於9月12日接受腹腔鏡子宮切除及雙側輸卵管切除手術時，卵巢被誤切。院方已向病人及家屬致歉，並提供跟進支援。
院方指主刀醫生在手術過程中出現短暫認知盲點，護士在檢查標本時發現卵巢並即時通知醫生。院方已於24小時內向衞生署呈報為嚴重醫療事故，並成立根本原因分析委員會；涉事醫生承認錯誤，將按員工守則接受紀律處分。
衞生署表示病人情況穩定，調查未發現醫院在處所、人手或設備方面違反實務守則。另一宗嚴重醫療事故涉及日間程序中心錯誤識別病人。
